newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's carrier Varig unit launches new routes.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's carrier Varig unit launches new routes.

text.p: Brazil's regional carrier Nordeste Linhas Aereas, controlled by airliner Varig, said it would launch by year-end 10 new routes throughout the northeast region and increase seats by 27 percent.
"We want to strengthen our operations in the northeast," said a company spokesman who asked not to be named.
Nordeste Linhas Aereas will also set daily flights from Sao Paulo to Salvador, capital of the northeastern state of Bahia, with a stop in Ilheus, a company spokesman said.
The new routes will allow the firm's revenues to rise to an estimated $55 million from $33.3 million last year, the spokesman said.
The firm is also studying leasing one Boeing 737-500 by the end of the year and five Embraer 145 jets in the first half of 1997, he added.
Currently, Nordeste Linhas Aereas has one Boeing 737-500, two Fokker-50s and four small 30-seat Brasilia jets.
